rules.province: province = the production province polygon that contains the outlet point (provBy 1); without a point, the register province text matched to the 77 production province names (provBy 2); otherwise unknown (-1)
rules.area: area = index of the data/areas.geojson subdistrict whose polygon contains the outlet point (seven covered provinces only); -1 elsewhere or without a point. Display only: register counts are never added to the restaurant snapshot
rules.evidence: cart = evidence_status names a cart point of sale; secondary = evidence_status starts with secondary / แหล่งรอง (pending brand confirmation); primary = brand, company or host published
rules.status: closed / temporary = the source declares a closure (not verified); pending = brand or current operation still to confirm; listed = listed by the source, not field-verified
rules.coordinate: lat/lon = the register selected coordinate (official locator, publisher or provider point; never a host or map centroid). geo: brand = brand/company locator, other = other source point, host = reference point of the host venue (not the shopfront). The register's separate approximate point (latitude_approx / longitude_approx, a venue reference) is counted in stats.approxOnly and never drawn

logos.rule: brand logo linked only when its sha256 equals a verified file in data/brand-logos.json (files shipped from the portable manifest or, since 0.7.1, from the register's own folder via --logo-files)
